Let's extract Kipchoge's marathon record times from Wikipedia using Python script via `run_command`.
```python
res = await run_command("""python3 -c "
import urllib.request, re
req = urllib.request.Request('https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Eliud_Kipchoge', headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
html = urllib.request.urlopen(req).read().decode('utf-8')
# clean html tags
text = re.sub('<[^<]+?>', '', html)
for m in re.finditer(r'2:01:\d\d|2:00:\d\d|1:59:\d\d', text):
    print(m.group(0))
"
""")
print(res)
```
